utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I suppose I can shift my usual grocery run to Sunday. I'll be there at 9 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll have my toolkit ready and see you then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, see you Saturday, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's Sunday now, at the community center. Or was it Saturday? I can never keep track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's definitely Sunday! Vik actually showed up early to test some tools—he's already fixed a rusty chain in record time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday it is! Vik's always on top of things. Wish I could keep dates straight like him.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Pia, before we go any further—have you actually seen this repair drive work with your own eyes, or is this something you were told?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I haven't actually seen it myself—I just heard about it from Nell. That's why I'm so worried about the timing and whether we'll have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's what I was afraid of. Let's not count on it until we get a reliable confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara! I've been hearing a lot about the repair drive this Saturday — are you planning to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh yes, I've got a few things lined up — I'm bringing extra tools, just in case anyone needs to borrow something.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great to hear, Mara! I was worried I'd show up with just my toaster and no tools nearby.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, Saturday? I've got my own car troubles—maybe I can swap a wrench for a favor?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Bo! Bring your car by too—maybe someone can take a look at it after we wrap up the Andersons'.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I'll bring my tool chest and the car. See you Saturday, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quinn, I heard the repair drive could use some extra hands—do you have any tools lying around we could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, absolutely! I've got a spare hammer and some screwdrivers—just bring them by tomorrow between 9 and noon for the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Quinn! I'll stop by around 10 to pick those up. Thanks a ton—every bit helps for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Dane, just a heads-up—the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks Rosa, I heard it got moved. Sunday at the community center works for me—I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, glad you can join! Let me know if you need any directions or have questions.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Vik, I heard you're in—the old playground definitely needs some love. Glad to have you on board.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ve been telling everyone about it—we’re going to get that place shining again!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Vik! Let's meet at the playground at 9 AM on Saturday. I'll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Uli, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard. Sunday works better for me anyway.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, so you're still in. You bringing anything specific to work on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Jules told me it was for the community center, but now Vik is talking about the playground too. I need to figure out which one's actually happening this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Quinn mention tools for tomorrow morning. Maybe you could check with them for the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's a good idea, Rey. I'll swing by Quinn's place later to get the straight story on where we're supposed to be.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's Saturday, Oren. Leo confirmed that works for him too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, 9 AM works. I'll bring my socket set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, 9 AM on Saturday it is. I'll check with Sam to see if he can make it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I sure did! I saw Vik get my old toaster buzzing again like new—sparks and all, right there at the community center yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You actually saw sparks? I'd need to see that with my own eyes before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, don't suppose you have any spare tools for the repair drive Saturday? I'm trying to round up an extra set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo! I've got a spare tool set I can lend you for the day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus, that's a huge help! I'll make sure to return it in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Leo, you heading to the repair drive too? I hear we're fixing up the Andersons' car this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Got some spare tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, the more hands the better. I'll bring my socket set just in case.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So, is it both the playground and the community center this weekend? I'm trying to figure out where to go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, it's the community center water pump repair drive this Saturday morning, no playground work this time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, just the community center then. I'll make sure to head there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I've got news! The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center—just so you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I heard. So we're all set for Sunday then?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure are! I'm bringing my squeaky lawn mower for Vik to work his magic on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I'll bring them by around 10. And I'd appreciate you checking my fence later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds great! I'll be there around 10:30 to take a look at the fence.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I'll see you then. Thanks again for squeezing that in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, sorry I'm late—did I hear right that the repair drive's now Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yeah, Dane, that's right! It's Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday on the front porch. I almost forgot myself.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, good—I was worried I'd missed it entirely. I can make Sunday work.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Noah, I think it's Saturday — I've been telling everyone that all week. Are you planning to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Huh, I could've sworn it was Sunday. I'll bring my old toolbox — got some wrenches kicking around somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, now I'm not sure either. Let me check with Oren again—he was the one who told me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, sorry, I'm in a rush. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, yeah, I guess so. Jules said Vik fixed some rusty chain thing super fast.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, so you haven't actually used the repair drive yourself? I just want to be sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Well, I've seen others use it successfully at the last cleanup, and I've tested it on my own broken chair—it held up fine. That's good enough for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So you personally tested it on your chair and it worked? That's the kind of evidence I was looking for.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mara, you should've seen Vik work on that rusty chain—like a magician with a wrench, I swear!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I believe it! Vik’s got a real knack for that sort of thing. Are you all set for the repair drive tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I'm ready! Got my old blender ready to go—figured if Vik can work magic on a chain, maybe he can revive this thing too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Guess you heard too, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday? Oh no, I already told my neighbor I could borrow my level on Saturday. What time on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Starts at 10, I think. Maybe you can still lend it out Saturday and pick it up after?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Vik, I'm so glad you're joining! Just a heads-up — the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sunday? Oh, I thought it was Saturday at the old playground! Thanks for the heads-up, Rosa—I'll be at the community center for sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, I'm so relieved you can still make it! I'll have the paint and tools ready by 9.
